# `armadad runtime`

<!-- Generated by `make docs` from the commands; do not edit. -->

[All commands](armadad.md)

runtime extracts the bundled containerd, runc, CNI plugins, and tini into the
data directory, verifies them, and replaces itself with containerd. It does
nothing on nodes that are not initialized yet.

```
armadad runtime [flags]
```

Flags:

| Flag | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `--bin-dir string` | use runtime binaries from this directory (builds without the bundle) |
| `--data-dir string` | Armada data directory (default `/var/lib/armada`) |

## `armadad runtime reset`

reset stops and removes all of Armada's containers on this node (those with
Armada's labels), the network sandboxes job queues are read from,
and the cluster network's interface and firewall rules.
Use it after `armada node delete`, with the agent (or server) stopped first,
or it starts its replicas again.

```
armadad runtime reset [flags]
```

Flags:

| Flag | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `--data-dir string` | Armada data directory (default `/var/lib/armada`) |
